castle.english: The bastion of the human Kingdom of Erathia, where Knights and Clerics champion a just and lawful realm. Gifted with the Resurrection spell and the highest morale of any army, its pikemen, griffins, and angels fight as the most balanced force in Antagarich.
castle.chinese: 人类王国埃拉西亚的堡垒，骑士与牧师在此守护正义而法度严明的国度。凭借复活法术与全阵营最高的士气，长枪兵、狮鹫与天使组成了安塔瑞亚最均衡的军队。

rampart.english: The mist-shrouded woodland of the elven nation AvLee, ruled by swift Rangers and nature-wise Druids. Every soldier moves like the wind—deadly Elven archers, spell-resistant guardians, and green dragons who shrug off magic itself.
rampart.chinese: 精灵国度阿维利薄雾笼罩的林地，由迅捷的游侠与通晓自然的德鲁伊统治。旗下兵种皆疾如风——致命的精灵弓手、抗性卓越的守护者，以及无视魔法的绿龙。

tower.english: The astral city of Bracada, where Wizards and Alchemists prize intellect above all. Gremlins tirelessly rebuild its walls, soulless golems feel no fear or doubt, and the thundering Titans crown a purely magical, construct-driven war machine.
tower.chinese: 布拉卡达的术士之城，术士与炼金术士将智慧奉于一切之上。小妖精不知疲倦地修复城墙，没有灵魂的魔像无畏无惑，而雷霆泰坦坐镇的，是一支纯粹由魔法与构装体驱动的战争机器。

inferno.english: The burning hellscape of Eeofol, where Demoniacs and Heretics unleash the legions of the underworld. Imps multiply without end, gogs hurl hellfire, and mighty devils crash upon the world in a storm of flame and ruin.
inferno.chinese: 伊欧弗尔灼热的地狱景象，恶魔与异教徒在此释放来自深渊的大军。小鬼无穷无尽地增殖，戈格投出地狱之火，强大的魔鬼以烈焰与毁灭的风暴席卷地表。

necropolis.english: The cursed land of Deya, where Death Knights and Necromancers reign over the unliving. With no fear and no morale, its skeletons, vampires, and liches grow mightier with every battle—for each fallen foe is raised anew as a servant of the grave.
necropolis.chinese: 迪雅的被诅咒之地，死亡骑士与亡灵法师统治着无生者。没有恐惧也没有士气，骷髅、吸血鬼与巫妖在每场战斗后都更加强大——因为每一个倒下的敌人，都会被重新唤醒，成为墓穴的奴仆。

dungeon.english: The subterranean realm of the dark elves, where cunning Overlords and Warlocks rule by treachery and arcane might. Blinding troglodytes, horned minotaurs, and the dread black dragons—immune to all magic—lurk within its shadowed halls.
dungeon.chinese: 黑暗精灵的地下国度，狡黠的领主与妖术师以诡计与奥术力量统治。致盲的穴居人、角蹄的牛头怪，以及令人生畏、对一切魔法免疫的黑龙，潜伏在幽暗的厅堂深处。

stronghold.english: The rugged fortress of the Krewlod barbarian tribes, where might alone is law. Barbarians and Beastmasters spurn wizardry entirely—their goblins, wolf riders, and earth-shaking behemoths win wars through raw strength and unbreakable courage.
stronghold.chinese: 克鲁洛德蛮族部落的粗犷堡垒，在这里力量即是唯一的法则。野蛮人与驯兽师彻底摒弃巫术——地精、狼骑兵与撼动大地的比蒙巨兽，靠的是纯粹的蛮力与不可摧折的勇悍。

fortress.english: The steaming swamps of Tatalia, home of the lizard folk led by Beastmasters and Witches. Thick-hided gnolls, regenerating warriors, and many-headed hydras make this the toughest, most tenacious army to wear down on the battlefield.
fortress.chinese: 塔塔利亚蒸腾的沼泽，蜥蜴人由驯兽师与女巫统领。皮坚肉厚的豺狼人、能够再生的战士与多头九头蛇，使这支军队成为战场上最难被拖垮、最具韧性的存在。

conflux.english: The elemental sanctuary born of Armageddon's Blade, where Planeswalkers and Elementalists commune with primal magic. Air, earth, fire, and water answer their call, forging a town whose very soldiers are living embodiments of the elements.
conflux.chinese: 《末日之刃》中诞生的元素圣地，元素法师与元素使在此与原始魔法共鸣。气、土、火、水听命于他们，锻造出一座以活生生的元素本身为士兵的城镇。
